name: pi-toolresult-guard
description: A malformed tool result must not kill the session. pi renders tool output with an unguarded result.content.filter(), so a tool that returns a bare string exits the process mid-turn; this repairs the result at the one point pi still allows it to be corrected.
author: coffeegrind123

scripts.lint: for file in extensions/index.ts src/*.ts tests/*.ts; do node --check "$file" 2>/dev/null || node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings -e "import('./$file').catch(e => { if (e.code === 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND') process.exit(0); console.error('$file:', e.message); process.exit(1) })"; done
